# LogRocket Blog

> A resource hub for product teams, engineers, and leaders covering development practices, product strategy, AI adoption, and digital experience optimization.

LogRocket Blog publishes in-depth guides, industry analysis, and expert interviews on modern software development, product management, and UX design. The blog features thought leadership from engineers and product leaders navigating AI-era challenges, alongside practical technical content on React, TypeScript, and emerging web technologies.

## Key Topics

- AI adoption
- Engineering leadership
- Product management
- TypeScript
- React
- Product-market fit
- Schema-driven development
- Knowledge sharing
- Token optimization
- UX design
- Engineering culture
- Performance optimization
- JSON Render
- Ask Galileo
- AI agents

## Core Sections

- [LogRocket Blog Home](https://blog.logrocket.com): LogRocket Blog homepage featuring resources for product teams
- [Dev](https://blog.logrocket.com/dev): Developer news and technology resources from LogRocket Blog
- [Product Management](https://blog.logrocket.com/product-management): Product management articles, interviews, and industry resources
- [UX Design](https://blog.logrocket.com/ux-design): UX design resources, interviews, and industry news

- [Thinking beats coding: How to hire the right engineers in the AI era](https://blog.logrocket.com/how-to-hire-the-right-engineers-in-the-ai-era): CTO Ken Pickering on prioritizing thinking skills in AI-era hiring

- [Your engineering team's AI training is probably failing: How to fix it](https://blog.logrocket.com/engineering-team-ai-training): Strategies for structured AI training and adoption in engineering teams
- [AI dev tool power rankings & comparison [March 2026]](https://blog.logrocket.com/ai-dev-tool-power-rankings): Comparison and rankings of top AI development tools and models
- [Stop wasting money on AI: 10 ways to cut token usage](https://blog.logrocket.com/stop-wasting-ai-tokens-10-ways-to-reduce-usage): 10 practical strategies to reduce LLM token usage and costs
- [Does splitting work across AI agents actually save time? I tested it.](https://blog.logrocket.com/splitting-across-ai-agents): Experimental analysis of work splitting across AI agents
